newsitem.title: USA: B.V.R. supplier fire may cause delays.
newsitem.headline: B.V.R. supplier fire may cause delays.

text.p: B.V.R. Technologies Ltd said on Wednesday that it received notice of a "sudden and substantial fire" at a supplier's facility that may cause big delays in delivering components.
B.V.R. said it was notified that the precise damage and consequences of the fire at an Israel Aircraft Industries MLM Division facility will be determined within 30 days.
The fire reportedly caused substantial damage to laboratories and storage areas.
B.V.R. said the letter it received said that, as a result of the fire, there may be possible delay in the delivery of certain components related to B.V.R. contracts.
B.V.R. has informed its customers and is evaluating the possible effects on its operations and financial performance.
B.V.R., based in Tel Aviv, Israel, makes advanced training and simulation systems for the aircraft and other industries. Its shares were trading down 1/4 to 5-3/4 at midday Wednesday.
